address: 3555 S Las Vegas Blvd, Las Vegas, NV 89109

zones.label: Pink Circle 2
zones.description: Pink Circle 2 follows the left side of the central performance area, close enough for strong detail while keeping an easy angle toward both the pole and stage.

zones.label: Pink Circle 3
zones.description: Pink Circle 3 is the straightest centered view into the room and the strongest single pick when you want the stage and central performance area lined up in front of you.

zones.label: Pink Circle 4
zones.description: Pink Circle 4 mirrors Pink 2 on the right side, staying close to the central performance area with a clean angle back toward the stage.

zones.label: VIP 1
zones.description: VIP 1 sits on the front-left side near the stage, a good choice when proximity matters more than being perfectly centered.

zones.label: VIP 2
zones.description: VIP 2 is a left-center table group that keeps the central performance area comfortably in view without paying for the Pink Circle tier.

zones.label: VIP 3
zones.description: VIP 3 is the centered VIP group behind Pink Circle 3, giving you a straight-on room view at a little more distance.

zones.label: VIP 4
zones.description: VIP 4 is the right-center counterpart to VIP 2, balancing a clear overall view with a closer cabaret feel.

zones.label: VIP 5
zones.description: VIP 5 is the front-right group near the stage, with a close cabaret view from that side of the room.

zones.label: General Admission · Left
zones.description: General Admission on the left keeps you in this intimate room at the value end of the ticket range, with a wider angle across the performance space.

zones.label: General Admission · Right
zones.description: General Admission on the right is the matching value-focused option, trading some centering for a lower ticket tier in a compact showroom.
